question: For whom the driver responsible if passengers are not wearing seatbelts?
options: For the passenger seated at the front.
For the passenger seated at the back.
explanation: Driver is accountable for not wearing the seatbelts for those passengers whose age is between 5 to 16 years.

question: What does a red light with a green arrow mean?
options: Proceed carefully in direction of the arrow and watch out for pedestrians.
explanation: Red light with green arrow means that the driver can cautiously proceed in the direction of arrow and also look for the pedestrians.

question: According to the law, green flashing signal represents:
explanation: Green flashing signal represents that you are allowed to move in any of the direction that is straight, right or left.

question: When should you be very careful while making a U-turn?
options: From 0m to 150m of a tunnel if view is not clear.
explanation: Drivers need to be alert while making U-Turn when they are 30meteres from the railway crossing as well as when the view of tunnel is not clear.

question: What do you need according to the law if you are involved in an accident?
options: Contact your car insurance provider only.
explanation: If any person is involved in the accident thein it's their duty to report the incident to the police immediately.

question: You need to report to MTO if you change your address within:
explanation: According to the law, if you change your address then you have to update this information to the Ministry of Transportation within 6 days after moving to the other place.

question: Suppose you reach an intersection and red light is flashing, what does it mean?
options: Come to a complete stop, proceed when it is safe.
Continue at normal speed and pass.
explanation: In such scenario you have to stop completely or you can proceed if it's safe to do so.

question: What is the maximum speed limit on a highway if there is no speed sign?
explanation: If there is no sign board on the highway regarding the speed, you can drive at maximum speed limit on highway which is 80km/h.

question: How should you enter a freeway?
options: Stop and safely merge with traffic when possible.
Slow down and safely merge with traffic.
Accelerate to the speed to the freeway and safely merge with traffic.
explanation: The right method to follow in order to enter the freeway is to increase the speed of you vehicle and merge carefully with the other traffic.

question: What should you do if your tire punctures while driving?
options: Hold steering firmly and keep the vehicle under control.
explanation: Firstly, you have to stop your vehicle immediately at a safe place. Secondly, you have to firmly hold the steering wheel and make sure that the vehicle is under the control.

question: If you drive under the influence of alcohol, for how long your license will be suspended?
explanation: Your Ontario driver's license will be suspended for 12 months in this case.

question: To qualify as an impaired driver, what should be your blood alcohol level?
explanation: If your blood alcohol level is greater than 0.08%, you are impaired in the eyes of law.

question: If you have a problem related to vision and it is on your driver's license, is it necessary to wear glasses or contact lenses while driving?
options: Only if you have difficulty in driving.
explanation: It is mandatory to wear your glasses or contact lenses while driving your vehicle.

question: According to the law, what should you do when there is a safety island and you see a vehicle is loading or unloading passengers?
options: Stay at least 10m clear of the island.
explanation: Do not obstruct the flow of traffic, pass carefully.

question: What should you do while exiting a freeway?
options: Give proper signal and maintain vehicle speed till you are off freeway.
Change your speed according to the posted speed limit or speed on exit ramp.
Move your vehicle to the closest lane to freeway exit.
explanation: You have to take care of all of the above points while exiting a freeway.

question: Drivers reach intersection from opposite sides, who has the right of way according to the law if first driver is going straight and other is turning left?
explanation: Drivers going straight have the right-of-way over anyone else on the road, unless there are pedestrians on the road.

question: What will happen if a police officer believes you are impaired and you refuse to take a breathalyzer test?
explanation: If you refuse to take a breathalyzer test, your license will be suspended for 90 days.

question: What is the correct thing to do in case of brake failure?
options: Have proper control over parking brakes.
explanation: You have to take care of all of the above points in case of failing brakes.

question: Why is it safer to look on your right side directly when changing lanes?
options: So you don't miss your blind spot.
Easier than using rear view mirror.
explanation: It is easy to miss blind spot while driving your car, you have to look at the side mirrors while changing lanes.

question: In which season should you use your snow tires?
options: In every season, because they are thick and have more grip on the road.
explanation: Snow tires should be used in winters in the cars to avoid slipping tires on the road.
